text: Laws tab on a brand-new 1-member nation says 'No one in Easternwood was LEFT to take your place' - past tense 'was left' reads as if members died; nobody ever joined. Members tab phrasing ('No heir: if you die now, your line ends.') is clearer.

By tick ~3700 (74 game s) 17 NationCreation chronicle events: almost every pawn raises its own banner within the first minute (Irene Taylor 15m from spawn founded Smallton before I could reach her). For a ruling goal this leaves very few nationless pawns to invite, and leaders never defect, so getting a first member / heir is hard.
Settlement screen: big world-space label '0 here, 1/8 residents' renders behind and through the 'CAMP OF EASTERNWOOD' header, both readable only with effort.
Objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left: shows 'nbers 1/10 · Buildings 0/2' instead of 'Members 1/10 · Buildings 0/2'.

~22 game-minutes into a reign (tick ~11400) still 1 member: no heir, so no Abdicate button and old age is suspended. Members/Laws tabs say 'No heir' but never tell the player HOW to get a member (invite a nationless Acquaintance with E, or build 2 owned stalls to draw immigrants, with taxes not High). Nearby pawns all founded their own one-pawn nations and leaders refuse invites. Succession could not be reached in a 45-minute session.
